verdict: APPROVE the isolated host revision for later application, after the survey packet is concrete and reviewed. The opt-in is exact and exclusive, layered strictly on the sealed native-only desktop mode, and requires exactly one built PDDARTSurvey fileset member. The 'pddartsurvey=1' boot argument is appended only when that gate passes, from one helper shared by the pre-reboot verification and the worker. Non-survey boot arguments are unchanged.
verified: dart_survey_enabled parses the build record with object_pairs_hook=image.unique (duplicate keys refused) and returns False when 'dart_survey_experiment' is absent. If present, it must equal {version 1, driver 'PDDARTSurvey', mode 'read_only', diagnostic_property 'PDDARTSurveyDiagnosticV1', device_initialization false}, with exact int/bool types. Then native_keyboard_desktop_enabled(inputs) must be true: the exact native opt-in, no keyboard/virtual/terminal experiment keys, a desktop opt-in, bound RAM, PDM1SPIHID/IOHIDFamily/IOGOP members, no PDSerialHID, and exactly one PDM1SPIHID entry. The survey member must appear in the inspected report, and the raw fileset must contain exactly one 'org.puredarwin.driver.PDDARTSurvey' LC_FILESET_ENTRY, with bounds-checked name offsets.

Single gate in both places: verify_inputs (the pre-reboot controller check) calls dart_survey_enabled after the other opt-ins, and the worker's boot arguments come from guest_bootargs(inputs), which re-runs the same gates. The new test asserts both call sites.

guest_bootargs = BOOTARGS + (' pdm1kbd=1' if keyboard or native) + (' pddartsurvey=1' if survey). For every non-survey packet this is byte-identical to the previous inline expression; survey mode implies native mode, so 'pdm1kbd=1 pddartsurvey=1'. The full string is 155 characters, on the same append path native runs already used for pdm1kbd=1. validate_bootargs checks the struct and has no token allowlist.
Sealing is unchanged: survey mode is reachable only in native mode, so ConsoleSession keeps the native writer state machine (bootstrap, challenge, launcher, sealed) with no HID scheduler.

Suites rerun on my scratch replay: test_dart_survey_progress 6/6, test_native_desktop_progress 7/7, test_host_progress 41/41, test_terminal_input_progress 11/11, test_virtual_input_progress 18/18, test_progress_source_fidelity 2/2, all OK.
